newsitem.title: FRANCE: Explosion aboard French navy ship off Cherbourg.
newsitem.headline: Explosion aboard French navy ship off Cherbourg.

text.p: An explosion occurred aboard a French navy support ship off the Channel port of Cherbourg on Wednesday, a navy spokesman said.
He said no further details were immediately available but a local radio station said the ship sank carrying an estimated crew of 30.
Radio France Cherbourg said one person was killed, four were missing and one was seriously injured.
The radio said the explosion aboard the 30 m (100 ft) vessel took place at 10.30 a.m. (0830 GMT) off Cape La Hague.
An official of the CROSS sea rescue service said two blasts were heard aboard the ship. The cause was not immediately known.
